integrity: Proof and formula are finite-field algebraic arguments; q=2 and q=4 exhaustive tests independently corroborate but do not prove all extension-field cases. No external verification or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to square powers in UT_5 of finite characteristic-two fields. Does not compute larger ranks, higher power words, odd-characteristic square fibers, or conjugacy-class refinements. The 2012 print publication of Bier precedes the oldest day-precise supporting online source located (Soffer, arXiv initial 2014-11-19); no earlier public calendar day is asserted. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Complete square-root fibers at the first unitriangular nonsurjectivity threshold
